correctness.rationale: Kuttner--Wang Lemmas 3.1--3.3 and Theorem 3.4 imply irreducible G iff beta^ell has order n, with A(0)=G(0). The norm of generator Gamma^e is eta^e, and the order condition is gcd(e,n)=1. In each norm class e=r+mj, primes dividing n and m force the exact support obstruction, while primes dividing n but not m give independent CRT exclusions. Every qualifying beta has degree d, yielding division by d. 96 complete abstract-group tests and 14 independent direct irreducibility enumerations pass.

value.rationale: The coefficient-fixed existence and exact multiplicities are motivated by prescribed-coefficient construction of irreducible projective polynomials. They form a natural complete classification and disclose an all-constants transition at ell=q-1 with gcd(d,q-1)=1. Aggregate enumeration alone cannot give this fiber support; the argument is self-contained beyond an explicitly cited nonstandard correspondence. No downstream theorem is necessary or claimed.
